chosenBy: Codex, applying Sunny’s Project source files and his October 17 changes

visualPolish.basis: The original Project parts stay. The drawing model chooses the arrangement, illustrations, borders and colors for each poster. No fixed poster grid. Saved completed drawings keep their original design.
visualPolish.parentCard: Four spoken lines from FORMAT; parent directions stay in companion notes.
visualPolish.evidenceLabels: Plain display labels only. Original classifications and complete limitations remain in records and companion notes.

story.basis: Age-aware writing guidance, not a word-count stop. Ages 8 to 10 aim for about 350 words, with 450 as advice. Older readers aim for about 600, with 750 as advice. Each new chapter needs a real page-fit check. Keep readable type and the actual concern; never pad a saved chapter.
story.paragraphs: Three short hook lines, then short paragraphs of everyday action and dialogue. Vary their length naturally. Real retellings use only supplied or confirmed events and quotes.

sourceSelectionBasis: At most two existing records nearest the printed finding and its boundary. Retain conflicting child breathing results. No source, finding, limitation or practice passage is rewritten; all records remain in the parent notes and kit evidence.
grownUp: The default fictional grown-up is a human man using he/him, short dark hair, blue sweater, dark trousers and brown shoes. Explicit cast records take precedence. This is an invented cast choice, never a claim about the real parent.
